discoveries.arabicText: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ

discoveries.title: Respect for Parents as an Act of Piety
discoveries.description: The Quran links respect for parents to piety and righteousness
discoveries.arabicText: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ

discoveries.title: Prayer for Divine Guidance
discoveries.description: The Quran encourages prayer as a means to seek guidance and mercy
discoveries.arabicText: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ

discoveries.title: Charity to Support the Needy
discoveries.description: The Quran recommends charity to help the poor and strengthen the community
discoveries.arabicText: وَآتَى الْمَالَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ ذَوِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينَ

discoveries.title: Preservation of Pharaoh's Body
discoveries.description: The Quran predicts the preservation of Pharaoh's body as a sign for future generations
discoveries.arabicText: فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ آيَةً

discoveries.title: Number of Days in the Year
discoveries.description: The word 'day' (yawm) appears 365 times, corresponding to the days in a solar year
discoveries.arabicText: وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا

discoveries.title: Number of Months in the Year
discoveries.description: The word 'month' (shahr) appears 12 times, corresponding to the months of the year
discoveries.arabicText: إِنَّ عِدَّةَ الشُّهُورِ عِندَ اللَّهِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا

discoveries.title: Balance Between Man and Woman
discoveries.description: The words 'man' (rajul) and 'woman' (imra'ah) each appear 24 times
discoveries.arabicText: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ

discoveries.title: Jesus and Adam Mentioned Equally
discoveries.description: The names 'Jesus' (Isa) and 'Adam' each appear 25 times, reflecting their similarity
discoveries.arabicText: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ آدَمَ

discoveries.title: Angels and Demons in Balance
discoveries.description: The words 'angel' (mala'ika) and 'demon' (shayatin) each appear 88 times
discoveries.arabicText: وَاتَّبَعُوا مَا تَتْلُو الشَّيَاطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَانَ

discoveries.title: Life and Death Balanced
discoveries.description: The words 'life' (hayat) and 'death' (mawt) each appear 145 times
discoveries.arabicText: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ

discoveries.title: This World and the Hereafter
discoveries.description: The terms 'this world' (dunya) and 'hereafter' (akhirah) each appear 115 times
discoveries.arabicText: أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا بِالْآخِرَةِ

discoveries.title: Significance of the Number 19
discoveries.description: The number 19 is mentioned as a sign in Surah Al-Muddathir
discoveries.arabicText: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ

discoveries.title: Frequency of the Word 'Allah'
discoveries.description: The word 'Allah' appears 2698 times, reflecting divine oneness
discoveries.arabicText: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ

discoveries.title: Mathematical Structure of Surahs
discoveries.description: The sum of surah numbers (1 to 114) equals 6555, a precise alignment
discoveries.arabicText: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

discoveries.title: Sum of Quranic Verses
discoveries.description: The total sum of Quranic verses is 6236, in numerical harmony
discoveries.arabicText: الم

discoveries.title: Balance Between Heaven and Earth
discoveries.description: The words 'heaven' (sama') and 'earth' (ard) each appear 38 times
discoveries.arabicText: وَالسَّمَاءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزَانَ

discoveries.title: Frequency of the Word 'Prophet'
discoveries.description: The word 'prophet' (nabi) appears 75 times, highlighting their role
discoveries.arabicText: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ

discoveries.title: Symmetry of Initial Letters
discoveries.description: The initial letters (fawatih) of surahs show numerical harmony
discoveries.arabicText: الم

discoveries.title: Frequency of the Word 'Light'
discoveries.description: The word 'light' (nur) appears 43 times, symbolizing divine guidance
discoveries.arabicText: اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ

discoveries.title: Balance Between Faith and Disbelief
discoveries.description: The words 'faith' (iman) and 'disbelief' (kufr) appear in balanced numbers
discoveries.arabicText: وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا قَاتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ

discoveries.title: Number 7 in the Quran
discoveries.description: The number 7, like the seven heavens, is a recurring numerical motif
discoveries.arabicText: الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا

discoveries.title: Frequency of the Word 'Sea'
discoveries.description: The word 'sea' (bahr) appears 32 times, reflecting its importance
discoveries.arabicText: مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ

discoveries.title: Harmony of Even and Odd Numbers
discoveries.description: The even and odd surah numbers balance perfectly
discoveries.arabicText: وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ

discoveries.title: Prohibition of Pork Meat
discoveries.description: The Quran prohibits pork consumption, related to health risks like parasitic diseases
discoveries.arabicText: إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنزِيرِ

discoveries.title: The Coccyx, the Indestructible Bone
discoveries.description: The Quran alludes to a bone (ajb adh-dhanab) as the basis for resurrection, interpreted as the coccyx
discoveries.arabicText: يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ

discoveries.title: Blind Heart
discoveries.description: The Quran describes blind hearts as incapable of understanding the truth
discoveries.arabicText: فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَى الْأَبْصَارُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَى الْقُلُوبُ الَّتِي فِي الصُّدُورِ

discoveries.title: Call to Reflection
discoveries.description: The Quran invites reflection on the signs of creation to strengthen faith
discoveries.arabicText: الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ

discoveries.title: Call to Meditation
discoveries.description: The Quran encourages meditation on divine verses to attain wisdom
discoveries.arabicText: يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا

discoveries.title: Call to Reasoning
discoveries.description: The Quran urges using reason to understand divine truths
discoveries.arabicText: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَا آيَةً بَيِّنَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

discoveries.title: Easy Memorization of the Noble Quran
discoveries.description: The Quran affirms it has been made easy to memorize for believers
discoveries.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

discoveries.title: Winds Blowing Over the Sea
discoveries.description: The Quran describes winds that stir the seas, facilitating navigation
discoveries.arabicText: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ الْجَوَارِ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ ۝ إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ

discoveries.title: Rain-Laden Clouds
discoveries.description: The Quran describes heavy clouds as bearers of rain for the earth
discoveries.arabicText: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنشِئُ السَّحَابَ الثِّقَالَ

discoveries.title: Drought and Resurrection
discoveries.description: The Quran compares revitalizing the earth after drought to resurrection
discoveries.arabicText: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنَّكَ تَرَى الْأَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَإِذَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ

discoveries.title: Women's Rights
discoveries.description: The Quran guarantees women equal rights in inheritance and dignity
discoveries.arabicText: لِّلرِّجَالِ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ وَلِلنِّسَاءِ نَصِيبٌ

discoveries.title: Thunder as a Divine Sign
discoveries.description: The Quran describes thunder as glorifying God, a sign of His power
discoveries.arabicText: وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ

discoveries.title: Protection of Women's Rights
discoveries.description: The Quran commands justice and equity toward women
discoveries.arabicText: وَعَاشِرُوهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ

discoveries.title: Heart Sealed by Blindness
discoveries.description: The Quran describes sealed hearts as unable to perceive guidance
discoveries.arabicText: خَتَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ

discoveries.title: Reflection on God's Signs
discoveries.description: The Quran calls to reflect on the heavens and earth to recognize the Creator
discoveries.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا فِي أَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ

discoveries.title: Meditation on Creation
discoveries.description: The Quran invites meditation on the creation of the heavens to deepen faith
discoveries.arabicText: قُلْ سِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَانظُرُوا كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الْخَلْقَ

discoveries.title: Reasoning for Truth
discoveries.description: The Quran encourages reasoning to distinguish truth from falsehood
discoveries.arabicText: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُوقِنِينَ

discoveries.title: Ease of Repeated Memorization
discoveries.description: The Quran emphasizes its ease of memorization for believers in several verses
discoveries.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

discoveries.title: Winds as Carriers of Rain
discoveries.description: The Quran describes winds as carriers of clouds and beneficial rain
discoveries.arabicText: وَأَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً

discoveries.title: Clouds as Water Reservoirs
discoveries.description: The Quran describes clouds as reservoirs of water to irrigate the earth
discoveries.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ

discoveries.title: Wisdom Behind Polygamy Up to Four Wives
discoveries.description: The Quran permits men to marry up to four wives, under conditions of justice and equity, to address social needs and protect women
discoveries.arabicText: فَانكِحُوا مَا طَابَ لَكُم مِّنَ النِّسَاءِ مَثْنَىٰ وَثُلَاثَ وَرُبَاعَ ۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا فَوَاحِدَةً

discoveries.title: Site of Noah's Ark (Mount Ararat)
discoveries.description: Archaeological explorations near Mount Ararat, Turkey, with tools and artifacts linked to Quranic and biblical flood narratives.

discoveries.title: City of Iram
discoveries.description: Remains discovered in the 1990s in Oman, identified as the city of Iram mentioned in the Quran, corroborated by Ebla tablets (2500-2250 BCE).

discoveries.title: Site of Al-Ula (Thamud)
discoveries.description: Remains at Al-Ula, Saudi Arabia, associated with the tribe of Thamud mentioned in the Quran, with Nabataean tombs and inscriptions.

discoveries.title: Preserved Body of Ramses II
discoveries.description: The mummified body of Ramses II, discovered in 1881, linked to the Quranic verse describing Pharaoh's body preserved as a sign.

discoveries.title: Ebla Tablets
discoveries.description: Cuneiform tablets (2500-2250 BCE) mentioning Quranic names and places like Iram, corroborating Quranic narratives.

discoveries.title: Inscriptions of Khaybar
discoveries.description: Remains of the city of Khaybar, mentioned in the Quran, with fortifications and traces of a 7th-century Jewish community.

discoveries.title: The Sleepers in the Cave
discoveries.description: The Quran recounts the story of youths who slept in a cave for centuries, protected by God, as a sign of His power
discoveries.arabicText: أَمْ حَسِبْتَ أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْكَهْفِ وَالرَّقِيمِ كَانُوا مِنْ آيَاتِنَا عَجَبًا

discoveries.title: The Traveler and the Resurrected Animal
discoveries.description: The Quran describes a traveler whose donkey was decomposed then reconstituted by God, demonstrating His ability to revive
discoveries.arabicText: أَوْ كَالَّذِي مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا

discoveries.title: The Treasures of Qarun
discoveries.description: The story of Qarun, swallowed with his treasures for arrogance, teaches the impermanence of material wealth before divine power
discoveries.arabicText: إِنَّ قَارُونَ كَانَ مِن قَوْمِ مُوسَىٰ فَبَغَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ

discoveries.title: The King Who Defied Ibrahim
discoveries.description: The king, often identified as Nimrod, tried to challenge Ibrahim by denying God but was humbled, showing divine omnipotence
discoveries.arabicText: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِي حَاجَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي رَبِّهِ

discoveries.title: The Two Brothers and the Harvests
discoveries.description: Two brothers disputing their fields received a miracle where God made their crops speak, teaching justice and generosity
discoveries.arabicText: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ابْنَيْ آدَمَ بِالْحَقِّ

discoveries.title: Moses and the Divine Scholar
discoveries.description: Moses accompanies a knowledgeable man (often identified as Al-Khidr) who teaches profound truths through miraculous acts
discoveries.arabicText: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ لَا أَبْرَحُ حَتَّىٰ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ

discoveries.title: The Queen of Sheba
discoveries.description: The Queen of Sheba, impressed by Solomon's miracles, submits to God, illustrating divine guidance through wonders
discoveries.arabicText: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَا أَرَى الْهُدْهُدَ

discoveries.title: Solomon and the Miraculous Horses
discoveries.description: Solomon, granted by God control over winds and animals, inspects his horses, a sign of his divine power
discoveries.arabicText: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ

discoveries.title: The Child Defending His Mother
discoveries.description: The infant Jesus speaks miraculously to defend his mother Mary's honor, proving his prophetic mission
discoveries.arabicText: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ ۖ قَالُوا يَا مَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا

discoveries.title: The Lowest Point on Earth
discoveries.description: The Quran mentions the Romans' defeat at the 'lowest point on earth,' identified as the Dead Sea region, confirmed by modern geography
discoveries.arabicText: غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ ۝ فِي أَدْنَى الْأَرْضِ

discoveries.title: Unique Fingerprints
discoveries.description: The Quran mentions fingerprints as a distinguishing sign for each individual, confirmed by modern criminology
discoveries.arabicText: بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ

discoveries.title: Seas That Do Not Mix
discoveries.description: The Quran describes a barrier between two seas preventing mixing, a phenomenon observed in estuaries and confirmed by oceanography
discoveries.arabicText: مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ ۝ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

discoveries.title: Haman as Pharaoh's Architect
discoveries.description: The Quran names Haman as a builder for Pharaoh, confirmed by Egyptian hieroglyphs identifying Haman as chief of quarry workers
discoveries.arabicText: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرِي فَأَوْقِدْ لِي يَا هَامَانُ عَلَى الطِّينِ

discoveries.title: Big Bang Theory
discoveries.description: The Quran describes the heavens and earth as a unified mass before their separation, aligned with the Big Bang theory
discoveries.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا

discoveries.title: Expansion of the Universe
discoveries.description: The Quran indicates that the heavens are expanding, corresponding to observed cosmic expansion
discoveries.arabicText: وَالسَّمَاءَ بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

discoveries.title: Spherical Shape of the Earth
discoveries.description: The Quran describes night wrapping around day, indicating the Earth's roundness
discoveries.arabicText: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ

discoveries.title: Reflected Light from the Moon
discoveries.description: The Quran distinguishes the sun's light as a lamp and the moon's light as reflected
discoveries.arabicText: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا

discoveries.title: Celestial Origin of Iron
discoveries.description: The Quran indicates that iron was sent down, corresponding to its meteoritic origin
discoveries.arabicText: وَأَنزَلْنَا الْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ

discoveries.title: Pairs in Creation
discoveries.description: The Quran mentions that everything is created in pairs, anticipating duality in biology and physics
